title: Split pins (Splinte)
notes: Callout: 'Splint ISO 1234 - 5 x 40' = nominal size 5 (the hole it fits), length 40 measured from under the eye to the end of the shorter leg.
The nominal size is the hole diameter; the pin wire itself is thinner (d max).
Wire cross-section is two half-rounds; the eye is formed from the same wire. a = leg length difference allowance, b = extended leg overhang, c = eye outer width.
